name: SEX, SIN & ROCK'N'ROLL 🤘🎸
source:
SEX, SIN & ROCK’N’ROLL is a 3D visual novel with side-scroller exploration, mixing rock music, mysticism, dark humor, and pure chaos into a story about fame, temptation, and the price of success.

You play as a broke musician stuck in a dying city until a cursed guitar, and the seductive demon bound to it, turns your band into an overnight sensation. Every sold-out show feeds the contract, while temptation and excess slowly pull you deeper into corruption.
Write songs, perform on rhythm-based live shows, meet strange and unique characters, and shape your story through branching choices and multiple endings.​

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4280130/SEX_SIN_ROCKNROLL/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《性、罪恶与摇滚乐》是一部融合横版卷轴探索玩法的3D视觉小说，将摇滚乐、神秘学、黑色幽默与纯粹的狂乱混沌融为一炉，讲述了一个关于名利、诱惑与成名代价的故事。

你将扮演一名困在垂死城市里的落魄乐手——直到一把受诅咒的吉他，以及束缚于琴身之上的妩媚恶魔，让你的乐队在一夜之间红遍天下。每一场座无虚席的演出都在喂养这份魔鬼契约，而无尽的诱惑与纵欲狂欢也正一步步将你拖向堕落的深渊。
谱写原创曲目、在节奏音游式的现场演出中纵情演奏、邂逅古怪独特的各色人物，并通过分支抉择与多重结局亲手谱写属于你的故事。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4280130/SEX_SIN_ROCKNROLL/]Steam[/url]]
